plp.title: Caran d'Ache + Paul Smith - 849 Blue & Green Ballpoint Pen

entity.name: Caran d'Ache + Paul Smith - 849 Blue & Green Ballpoint Pen
entity.short_description_text:
Now in its fourth edition, our collaboration with the iconic Swiss stationer is a celebration of colour and creativity, as well as Paul’s long-time love of the Caran d’Ache 849 pen.

With a two-tone colour scheme – a graphic nod to Paul’s popular stripe motifs – each combination has been carefully chosen to contrast, clash or coordinate, reflecting Paul’s clever use of colour.

Made in Switzerland with a strong aluminium hexagonal body and a flexible clip, this pen is finished with a Paul Smith signature on the body. 

Presented in a slim, padded case bearing the aforementioned two-tone colour scheme, this pen comes with a black medium Goliath ink cartridge which lasts up to 600 A4 pages.

entity.features_information_text:
* Made in Britain
* Sterling Silver
* Lab yellow Sapphire
* 20 inch Figaro chain 

[b]Alec Doherty[/b]

Alec Doherty is an artist working in London, UK. 
His work is about nuances of human behaviour, often focused on interaction and body language. Alec works with different mediums, from pencil on paper through to large scale sculpture. In 2021 Alec incorporated his jewellery company, an extension of his creative practice, creating fine jewellery for all genders. Made in Britain.

His latest jewellery collection exclusive for Paul Smith, was inspired by the stories of challenging moments and turning points in the lives of his friends and family – the series gives us a glimpse into the lives of others; first kisses, going to prison, giving birth. Stories different to our own, but with shared emotion, a nervous energy we can all relate to and an ability to embrace change.

The collection features six rings and eight necklaces which are made from silver set with Gemstones and engravings representing the wearer’s inner spirit.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith kettle features a unique combination of colours which is exclusive to Paul Smith. Paul’s doodles are engraved into the lid of the kettle featuring birds and ‘Paul Smith’ in sky writing.

The 9093 kettle, with bird-shaped whistle is one of the best-selling Alessi objects in the world. The design of this kettle, created by Michael Graves in 1985, mixes the influences taken from European Art, American Pop and quotes from pre-Columbian cultures. Graves's unique visual language is the reason behind the extraordinary success that the kettle has had since the year of its production. It is a smart object, elegant, but at the same time playful and fun: when the water starts boiling, the bird sings, leading to an inevitable smile.

relatedColors.meta_title_text: Alessi x Paul Smith - Wine Box Set
relatedColors.product_description_text:
Set composed of sommelier corkscrew “Parrot - Proust” in cast aluminium and PC hand decorated, “Noè” wine and champagne bottle stopper with expanding seal in 18/10 stainless steel and “Sitges” bottle coaster in 18/10 stainless steel.

Objects for serving wine have always been an area of specialisation for Alessi. The first catalogues published in the 1920s and 1930s already presented a wide variety of products from champagne glasses to coolers, from flask holders to liqueur services. Over the years, the exploration of this world has led to the creation of objects that have become iconic, such as the collection of bar and wine accessories designed by Ettore Sottsass in the 1970s or the Anna G. Corkscrew created by Alessandro Mendini in 1994. The Alessi & Wine set pays tribute to this long design tradition, offering a selection of essential accessories to complement the service of wine.

entity.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith kettle features a unique combination of colours which is exclusive to Paul Smith. Paul’s doodles are engraved into the lid of the kettle featuring birds and ‘Paul Smith’ in sky writing.

The 9093 kettle, with bird-shaped whistle is one of the best-selling Alessi objects in the world. The design of this kettle, created by Michael Graves in 1985, mixes the influences taken from European Art, American Pop and quotes from pre-Columbian cultures. Graves's unique visual language is the reason behind the extraordinary success that the kettle has had since the year of its production. It is a smart object, elegant, but at the same time playful and fun: when the water starts boiling, the bird sings, leading to an inevitable smile.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
Set composed of sommelier corkscrew “Parrot - Proust” in cast aluminium and PC hand decorated, “Noè” wine and champagne bottle stopper with expanding seal in 18/10 stainless steel and “Sitges” bottle coaster in 18/10 stainless steel.

Objects for serving wine have always been an area of specialisation for Alessi. The first catalogues published in the 1920s and 1930s already presented a wide variety of products from champagne glasses to coolers, from flask holders to liqueur services. Over the years, the exploration of this world has led to the creation of objects that have become iconic, such as the collection of bar and wine accessories designed by Ettore Sottsass in the 1970s or the Anna G. Corkscrew created by Alessandro Mendini in 1994. The Alessi & Wine set pays tribute to this long design tradition, offering a selection of essential accessories to complement the service of wine.

entity.meta_title_text: Alessi x Paul Smith - Wine Box Set
entity.product_description_text:
Set composed of sommelier corkscrew “Parrot - Proust” in cast aluminium and PC hand decorated, “Noè” wine and champagne bottle stopper with expanding seal in 18/10 stainless steel and “Sitges” bottle coaster in 18/10 stainless steel.

Objects for serving wine have always been an area of specialisation for Alessi. The first catalogues published in the 1920s and 1930s already presented a wide variety of products from champagne glasses to coolers, from flask holders to liqueur services. Over the years, the exploration of this world has led to the creation of objects that have become iconic, such as the collection of bar and wine accessories designed by Ettore Sottsass in the 1970s or the Anna G. Corkscrew created by Alessandro Mendini in 1994. The Alessi & Wine set pays tribute to this long design tradition, offering a selection of essential accessories to complement the service of wine.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith kettle features a unique combination of colours which is exclusive to Paul Smith. Paul’s doodles are engraved into the lid of the kettle featuring birds and ‘Paul Smith’ in sky writing.

The 9093 kettle, with bird-shaped whistle is one of the best-selling Alessi objects in the world. The design of this kettle, created by Michael Graves in 1985, mixes the influences taken from European Art, American Pop and quotes from pre-Columbian cultures. Graves's unique visual language is the reason behind the extraordinary success that the kettle has had since the year of its production. It is a smart object, elegant, but at the same time playful and fun: when the water starts boiling, the bird sings, leading to an inevitable smile.

entity.product_description_text:
We have once again teamed up with Brighton-based gomi to turn waste plastic from our supply chain into wireless chargers and charging cables featuring a melted, psychedelic version of our beloved Signature Stripe.

gomi tag is a super-easy, sustainable way to keep track of what matters.

It uses Bluetooth technology and the Apple 'Find My' App to securely report its location straight to your iPhone or iPad.
Made from waste and built to last. Attach one to your keys, bag, or even your pet’s collar, so they’re always within reach. Never lose what you love while supporting a circular future.
Once the tag is paired with your Apple device, only you or people you share it with can see its location.
Through the app, the tag can be made to play a loud noise to help you locate it, if it is buried in the bottom of a bag or a drawer.

[b]Dimensions[/b]
200mm (W) x 95mm (H) x 70mm (D)

32 hours at normal listening volume

Up to 10 metre range

UKCA, CE, ROHS, REACH

gomi speaker, 2 metre USB-C to USB-C charging cable*, manual,

[b]gomi[/b]

gomi was created with a clear sense of purpose - to make beautiful products that last.
Their design philosophy is that tech shouldn’t become obsolete. Instead, we design for circular lifespans. Waste plastics and second-life batteries form the building blocks. Modular design allows gomi to fix what might otherwise have been thrown away.

Casing made from 100% ‘non-recyclable’ plastics sourced from waste flows around the UK, gomi is designed to last.

entity.meta_title_text: Threads by Sir Paul Smith Special Edition
entity.product_description_text:
[b]This edition of Threads features an exclusive cover design available only at Paul Smith, perfect for collectors and fans alike.[/b] 

We invite you to dive into the world of Sir Paul Smith, with our special edition copy of Threads. Sir Paul’s journey has been anything but conventional: from leaving school at fifteen with a dream of being a professional racing cyclist to a life-altering accident that would change everything. After meeting the love of his life and immersing himself in the exciting new world of the 1960s London art and fashion scene, he would go on to build a global fashion empire that started off as a tiny shop tucked behind a dark, damp corridor in Nottingham. 

From a Nottingham alleyway to a global empire, this is the story of a truly unique British fashion icon. For the first time, and with his signature wit, Paul shares candid memories of a life in style, including what it was like to dress legends including David Bowie, Daniel Day-Lewis, Giorgio Armani and Sir Alex Ferguson; how he fought to keep his brand independent in a world of globalized homogeneity. Join him as he shares why, after five decades of success, you can still find him on the shopfloor every Saturday meeting his customers.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith kettle features a unique combination of colours which is exclusive to Paul Smith. Paul’s doodles are engraved into the lid of the kettle featuring birds and ‘Paul Smith’ in sky writing.

The 9093 kettle, with bird-shaped whistle is one of the best-selling Alessi objects in the world. The design of this kettle, created by Michael Graves in 1985, mixes the influences taken from European Art, American Pop and quotes from pre-Columbian cultures. Graves's unique visual language is the reason behind the extraordinary success that the kettle has had since the year of its production. It is a smart object, elegant, but at the same time playful and fun: when the water starts boiling, the bird sings, leading to an inevitable smile.

Set composed of sommelier corkscrew “Parrot - Proust” in cast aluminium and PC hand decorated, “Noè” wine and champagne bottle stopper with expanding seal in 18/10 stainless steel and “Sitges” bottle coaster in 18/10 stainless steel.

Objects for serving wine have always been an area of specialisation for Alessi. The first catalogues published in the 1920s and 1930s already presented a wide variety of products from champagne glasses to coolers, from flask holders to liqueur services. Over the years, the exploration of this world has led to the creation of objects that have become iconic, such as the collection of bar and wine accessories designed by Ettore Sottsass in the 1970s or the Anna G. Corkscrew created by Alessandro Mendini in 1994. The Alessi & Wine set pays tribute to this long design tradition, offering a selection of essential accessories to complement the service of wine.

entity.meta_title_text: Jaques of London - Garden Boule Set
entity.product_description_text:
Bring a touch of France to your garden or beach day with Jaques of London’s 8 Boule Set – the ultimate outdoor game of skill, strategy, and precision! Known as Boules or Petanque, this traditional European game is perfect for relaxed yet competitive play between friends or family. The goal is simple: throw your polished metal boules and get them as close as possible to the small wooden jack (or ''butt'') – it’s a game of finesse, focus, and a whole lot of fun!

Beautifully presented in a zipped canvas carry case, this premium set includes eight polished alloy boules designed for long-lasting play. Whether you're on the lawn, beach, or village green, this set brings people together for a timeless, sociable game steeped in tradition.

entity.meta_description_text: Made in Switzerland with a brass body with a platinum finish, this pen features a hexagonal shape with milled 'Shadow Stripe' guilloché pattern.
entity.meta_title_text: Caran d'Ache + Paul Smith - Ecridor Silver Ball Point Pen and Leather Pouch Set
entity.product_description_text:
For over ten years, Caran d’Ache and Paul Smith have celebrated their shared passion for colour, design and audacity. With this 5th edition, the Swiss Maison and the British designer playfully push boundaries to reinvent the art of the beautifully crafted object.

Made in Switzerland with a brass body with a platinum finish, this pen features a hexagonal shape with milled 'Shadow Stripe' guilloché pattern. ‘Paul Smith’ and ‘Write it down’ signatures, originally handwritten by Paul Smith are engraved in guilloché using a milling cutter.

Complete with a smooth black cowhide leather pouch with ‘Shadow Stripe’ emboss with an intuitive opening inspired by eyewear cases.

Presented in a raw silver-effect metal case with a black Caran d’Ache + Paul Smith logo on the outside.

entity.name: Paul Smith Bookworm 3-Wick Scented Candle, 1000g
entity.excerpt:
Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion in large rooms. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When lit, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and once burned, it can be reused again and again. Why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?         

Fragrance notes: Grapefruit, Amber, Pimento, Cedarwood.

relatedColors.excerptHtml:
Blended with premium and alcohol-free ingredients, this diffuser is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The oil is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting collar, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. relatedColors.features_information_text:
250ml e 8.4 fl oz

Fragrance notes: Lemon, Black Pepper, Vetiver, Moss     

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith kettle features a unique combination of colours which is exclusive to Paul Smith. Paul’s doodles are engraved into the lid of the kettle featuring birds and ‘Paul Smith’ in sky writing.

The 9093 kettle, with bird-shaped whistle is one of the best-selling Alessi objects in the world. The design of this kettle, created by Michael Graves in 1985, mixes the influences taken from European Art, American Pop and quotes from pre-Columbian cultures. Graves's unique visual language is the reason behind the extraordinary success that the kettle has had since the year of its production. It is a smart object, elegant, but at the same time playful and fun: when the water starts boiling, the bird sings, leading to an inevitable smile.

Set composed of sommelier corkscrew “Parrot - Proust” in cast aluminium and PC hand decorated, “Noè” wine and champagne bottle stopper with expanding seal in 18/10 stainless steel and “Sitges” bottle coaster in 18/10 stainless steel.

Objects for serving wine have always been an area of specialisation for Alessi. The first catalogues published in the 1920s and 1930s already presented a wide variety of products from champagne glasses to coolers, from flask holders to liqueur services. Over the years, the exploration of this world has led to the creation of objects that have become iconic, such as the collection of bar and wine accessories designed by Ettore Sottsass in the 1970s or the Anna G. Corkscrew created by Alessandro Mendini in 1994. The Alessi & Wine set pays tribute to this long design tradition, offering a selection of essential accessories to complement the service of wine.

relatedColors.meta_title_text: Alessi x Paul Smith - Moka Pot
relatedColors.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith moka pot features Paul’s handwriting: ‘Every day is a new beginning’ engraved into the lid.

A coffee maker with a familiar and at the same time innovative form. Designed by architect David Chipperfield, Moka is an artist's interpretation of a timeless icon of the Italian culture. Chipperfield introduces a series of details that make the Moka design new and even more functional, such as the flat lid on which to place the cups to be heated - allowing optimum enjoyment of the aroma and flavour of the drink. For those who don't want to compromise on the unmistakeable taste of coffee prepared with an espresso coffee maker.

The “826” basket belongs to a category of objects that have been present in the domestic household for centuries: the metal wire basket. It was the first object to result from the technological research into folded metal wire carried out by the Alessi Technical Office in the second half of the 1940s.

entity.name: Paul Smith Daydreamer 3-Wick Scented Candle, 1000g
entity.excerpt:
Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion in large rooms. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When lit, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and once burned, it can be reused again and again. Why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

Fragrance notes: Verbena, Clary Sage, Lavender, Hay.

relatedColors.features_information_text:
Fragrance notes: Italian bergamot, mandarin, and basil.

250ml e 8.4 fl oz

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

relatedColors.name: Paul Smith Sunseeker Diffuser, 250ml
relatedColors.excerpt:
The latest addition to the Paul Smith Home Collection's home fragrance line, new for Spring Summer 2023, Sunseeker and is a summery scent that’ll have you dreaming of Italy.

Blended with premium and alcohol-free ingredients, this diffuser is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The oil is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting collar, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When in use, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and when finished, it can be reused again and again with fresh reeds or even as a stem vase for flowers.

Fragrance notes: Italian bergamot, mandarin, and basil.

250ml e 8.4 fl oz

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

entity.product_description_text:
Conjuring the lush, green atmosphere of a florist’s shop, Leaf is composed of cut flower stems, freesia, lily, and patchouli. Its bright, fresh character echoes one of Paul’s favourite sayings: every day is a new beginning.

Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When lit, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and once burned, it can be reused again and again. Why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

products.name: Caran d'Ache + Paul Smith - 849 Blue & Green Ballpoint Pen
products.excerpt:
Now in its fourth edition, our collaboration with the iconic Swiss stationer is a celebration of colour and creativity, as well as Paul’s long-time love of the Caran d’Ache 849 pen.

With a two-tone colour scheme – a graphic nod to Paul’s popular stripe motifs – each combination has been carefully chosen to contrast, clash or coordinate, reflecting Paul’s clever use of colour.

Made in Switzerland with a strong aluminium hexagonal body and a flexible clip, this pen is finished with a Paul Smith signature on the body. 

Presented in a slim, padded case bearing the aforementioned two-tone colour scheme, this pen comes with a black medium Goliath ink cartridge which lasts up to 600 A4 pages.

relatedColors.name: 'Signature Stripe' Notebook & Caran d'Ache Two-Tone Pen Gift Set
relatedColors.features_information_text:
This gift set includes:

[b]'Signature Stripe' Notebook[/b]

This lined paperback notebook features a Paul Smith signature page footer, black ribbon marker and gold-foil page edging.

This classic notebook is finished with a bold, removable black paper card slip across the centre exterior, finished with a gold Paul Smith signature.

Size: 21 x 15.3cm

100% Paper, lined

[b]Caran d'Ache + Paul Smith - 849 Red & Pink Ballpoint Pen[/b]

Now in its fourth edition, our collaboration with the iconic Swiss stationer is a celebration of colour and creativity, as well as Paul’s long-time love of the Caran d’Ache 849 pen.

With a two-tone colour scheme – a graphic nod to Paul’s popular stripe motifs – each combination has been carefully chosen to contrast, clash or coordinate, reflecting Paul’s clever use of colour.

Made in Switzerland with a strong aluminium hexagonal body and a flexible clip, this pen is finished with a Paul Smith signature on the body.

Presented in a slim, padded case bearing the aforementioned two-tone colour scheme, this pen comes with a black medium Goliath ink cartridge which lasts up to 600 A4 pages.

Pen size: 12.8 x 1cm

Case size: 20 x 6cm

entity.name: Paul Smith Jasmine Scented Candle, 240g
gift_budget_quiz: I'd like to spoil them (within reason)
entity.features_information_text:
- 240g e 8.4oz
- Height: 12cm / 4.7in
- Diameter: 8cm / 3.1in
- Fragrance notes: Jasmine, gardenia, cypress, sandalwood
- Burn time: 60 hours 

CAUTION: Only burn this candle on a level, heat resistant surface. Do not burn for more than 4 hours at a time. Keep wick trimmed to 5mm. Stop using when 10mm of wax remains or wick disk becomes visible. Allow wax to harden before moving. Take care when extinguishing the flame. Keep candles 10cm apart and allow headroom for flame.
entity.meta_description_text: Paul Smith Jasmine Scented Candle, 240g with notes of jasmine, gardenia, cypress, sandalwood.
entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith Jasmine Scented Candle, 240g
entity.product_description_text:
A heady, sweet medley of jasmine, gardenia and sandalwood evokes the hidden courtyard garden at Paul Smith’s Paris office. Draped in jasmine vines, the garden comes to life of a spring evening.

Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When lit, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and once burned, it can be reused again and again. Why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

entity.name: Paul Smith Rose Diffuser, 250ml
gift_budget_quiz: I don't have a budget in mind
I don't want to break the bank
I'd like to spoil them (within reason)
entity.features_information_text:
Fragrance notes: Rose, Bergamot, Geranium, Lily of the Valley.

250ml e 8.4 fl oz

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.
entity.meta_description_text: Blended with premium and alcohol-free ingredients, this diffuser is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion.
entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith Rose Diffuser, 250ml
entity.product_description_text:
Inspired by Paul’s wife who had a rose variety named after him as a gift. A beautiful, modern rose tailored with geranium and bergamot. The glass is a nod to the bold pink exterior of the iconic Paul Smith store on Melrose Avenue in LA.

Blended with premium and alcohol-free ingredients, this diffuser is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The oil is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting collar, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When in use, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and when finished, it can be reused again and again with fresh reeds or even as a stem vase for flowers.

entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith Rose Scented Candle, 240g
entity.product_description_text:
As a gift to her husband, Paul’s wife had a variety of rose named after him, a gesture which inspired this fragrance. Built around a heart of full-bodied rose, it is complemented by notes of geranium and bergamot.

Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When lit, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and once burned, it can be reused again and again. Why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

relatedColors.name: Paul Smith Sunseeker Diffuser, 250ml
relatedColors.excerpt:
The latest addition to the Paul Smith Home Collection's home fragrance line, new for Spring Summer 2023, Sunseeker and is a summery scent that’ll have you dreaming of Italy.

Blended with premium and alcohol-free ingredients, this diffuser is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The oil is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting collar, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When in use, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and when finished, it can be reused again and again with fresh reeds or even as a stem vase for flowers.

Fragrance notes: Italian bergamot, mandarin, and basil.

250ml e 8.4 fl oz

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

entity.meta_description_text: This innovative book captures the unique spirit of British fashion icon Sir Paul Smith through 50 objects chosen by Sir Paul himself for the inspiration they have provided him over the years
entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith - 50th Anniversary Book - New Edition
entity.product_description_text:
Edited by Tony Chambers, with a foreword by Jonathan Ive and a new preface by Sir Paul Smith

This innovative book captures the unique spirit of British fashion icon Sir Paul Smith through 50 objects chosen by Sir Paul himself for the inspiration they have provided him over the years – from a wax plate of spaghetti and a Dieter Rams radio to a Mario Bellini Cab chair and a bicycle seat.

Each object has impacted his worldview, his creative process, and his adherence to a design approach that’s always imbued with distinctly British wit and eccentricity. The book covers subjects as varied as breaking down the formality of wearing a suit, the importance of wit, and the benefits of remaining independent in an increasingly monopolized world, and includes personal contributions – handwritten notes, a sketch, or photograph – from such fashion and design heavyweights as Manolo Blahnik, Inès de la Fressange, Martin Parr, and John Pawson.

Updated with a fresh new fabric cover featuring the brand’s signature stripe and a brand-new preface written by Sir Paul especially for this edition, Paul Smith provides the ultimate insight into one of the fashion world’s most-loved creators.

entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith - 50th Anniversary Book - New Edition - Signed Edition
entity.product_description_text:
Edited by Tony Chambers, with a foreword by Jonathan Ive and a new preface by Sir Paul Smith

This innovative book captures the unique spirit of British fashion icon Sir Paul Smith through 50 objects chosen by Sir Paul himself for the inspiration they have provided him over the years – from a wax plate of spaghetti and a Dieter Rams radio to a Mario Bellini Cab chair and a bicycle seat.

Each object has impacted his worldview, his creative process, and his adherence to a design approach that’s always imbued with distinctly British wit and eccentricity. The book covers subjects as varied as breaking down the formality of wearing a suit, the importance of wit, and the benefits of remaining independent in an increasingly monopolized world, and includes personal contributions – handwritten notes, a sketch, or photograph – from such fashion and design heavyweights as Manolo Blahnik, Inès de la Fressange, Martin Parr, and John Pawson.

Updated with a fresh new fabric cover featuring the brand’s signature stripe and a brand-new preface written by Sir Paul especially for this edition, Paul Smith provides the ultimate insight into one of the fashion world’s most-loved creators.

Aerodynamics is at the forefront of Utopia’s design with ventilation also a key factor considered during its development. Suitable for road racing and triathlon, Utopia can be used year-round in all climates, due to its refined design to keep the rider cool, especially when riding at high speed.

Utopia uses a breathable and quick-dry padding, offering a 5mm layer of fast-wicking material called Resistex®* that takes moisture away from the rider’s head and moves it to the helmet’s outer shell, contributing to a helmet that’s comfortable to wear all day.

entity.excerpt:

entity.features_information_text:
250ml e 8.4 fl oz

Fragrance notes: Rain, Iris, Suede, Patchouli 

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

The oil is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting collar, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. relatedColors.features_information_text:
250ml e 8.4 fl oz

Fragrance notes: Lemon, Black Pepper, Vetiver, Moss     

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

For London Craft Week Paul Smith's Foundation launches an annual grant to celebrate British makers. 'British Makers - Glass' is a new initiative that gives a cash award to five British glassblowers to develop a new product in response to a creative brief, set by Sir Paul Smith - to reimagine the water jug. 

Glassblowers worked to specific briefs set out by the Paul Smith Home and Interiors team. These are: Humour, Pattern, Form, Stripe and Colour
entity.meta_description_text: In 2020, with a distinct aesthetic and refined skillset, Phoebe founded Gather. Gather is a modern British glassmaking studio in Woolwich, London.
entity.meta_title_text: Gather for Paul Smith's Foundation - Large Water Jug
entity.product_description_text:
Phoebe Stubbs discovered glass twenty years ago at an introductory workshop. The weight, heat, and tactility of the material left a lasting impression. She left interior design to train intensively, studied at the Rhode Island School of Design, and honed her craft alongside leading glassmakers through apprenticeships and assistant roles.

In 2020, with a distinct aesthetic and refined skillset, Phoebe founded Gather. Gather is a modern British glassmaking studio in Woolwich, London. We make handblown glassware, contemporary lighting and craft experiences, all shaped by hand in our London hotshop.

entity.name: Paul Smith Early Bird Scented Candle, 240g
entity.excerpt:
Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. Once burned, why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

Fragrance notes: Rain, Iris, Suede, Patchouli.

CAUTION: Only burn this candle on a level, heat resistant surface. Do not burn for more than 4 hours at a time. Keep wick trimmed to 5mm. relatedColors.meta_title_text: Paul Smith Leaf Scented Candle, 240g
relatedColors.product_description_text:
Conjuring the lush, green atmosphere of a florist’s shop, Leaf is composed of cut flower stems, freesia, lily, and patchouli. Its bright, fresh character echoes one of Paul’s favourite sayings: every day is a new beginning.

Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When lit, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and once burned, it can be reused again and again. Why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

relatedColors.features_information_text:
250ml e 8.4 fl oz

Fragrance notes: Rain, Iris, Suede, Patchouli 

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

relatedColors.name: Paul Smith Sunseeker Diffuser, 250ml
relatedColors.excerpt:
The latest addition to the Paul Smith Home Collection's home fragrance line, new for Spring Summer 2023, Sunseeker and is a summery scent that’ll have you dreaming of Italy.

Blended with premium and alcohol-free ingredients, this diffuser is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The oil is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting collar, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When in use, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and when finished, it can be reused again and again with fresh reeds or even as a stem vase for flowers.

relatedColors.features_information_text:
Fragrance notes: Italian bergamot, mandarin, and basil.

250ml e 8.4 fl oz

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
Bring a touch of France to your garden or beach day with Jaques of London’s 8 Boule Set – the ultimate outdoor game of skill, strategy, and precision! Known as Boules or Petanque, this traditional European game is perfect for relaxed yet competitive play between friends or family. The goal is simple: throw your polished metal boules and get them as close as possible to the small wooden jack (or ''butt'') – it’s a game of finesse, focus, and a whole lot of fun!

Beautifully presented in a zipped canvas carry case, this premium set includes eight polished alloy boules designed for long-lasting play. Whether you're on the lawn, beach, or village green, this set brings people together for a timeless, sociable game steeped in tradition.

entity.meta_title_text: Stewart Hearn for Paul Smith Foundation - Blue Owl Water Jug
entity.product_description_text:
Stewart Hearn is a master glassmaker, graduating from Sunderland Polytechnic in 1986. He has taken London Glassworks from strength to strength since its inception in 2002. 

Stewart's designs have a studied balance of form, colour translucency and weight that show tacit knowledge, command and someone at ease with an ancient craft.

As a recognised and accomplished glass artist Stewart is able to focus on limited edition and unique pieces which is what he enjoys making the most. In addition to this work, he produces glass for a range of clients and in various capacities.

entity.meta_title_text: Ratio by Paul Smith x The Rug Company - Takt Indigo Rug
entity.product_description_text:
In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

[b]Takt Indigo[/b] is guided by the Bauhaus ideas of proportion and geometry, bringing pattern into a more tactile, dimensional space. Blocks of varied cool tones and shifting textures create a dimensional surface, while New Zealand wool adds depth and a gentle vintage feel to the palette. 

Newly, Takt highlights two construction techniques: Tulu and Indo-Nepali handknot. This technical innovation, executed in collaboration with our artisans, delivers a sculptural rug that changes character as you experience it: graphic from afar and richly textured up close.

[b]Size shown in imagery does not always represent the size available to buy online. If you require a larger size, please contact customer services directly.[/b]

In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order. 

[b]Raster Natural[/b] softens its graphic design through texture. Bold blocks and stripes in neutral tones sit against a richly tactile ground, creating a quiet interplay between pattern and surface. Handknotted in New Zealand wool using the Tulu technique, rows of cut pile and flatweave bring depth and movement to the Bauhaus-inspired design.

[b]Size shown in imagery does not always represent the size available to buy online. If you require a larger size, please contact customer services directly.[/b]

entity.meta_title_text: Ratio by Paul Smith x The Rug Company - Takt Ash Rug
entity.product_description_text:
In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order. 

[b]Takt Ash[/b] is guided by the Bauhaus ideas of proportion and geometry, bringing pattern into a more tactile, dimensional space. Blocks of varied grey tones and shifting textures create a dimensional surface, while New Zealand wool adds depth and a gentle vintage feel to the palette. 

Newly, Takt highlights two construction techniques: Tulu and Indo-Nepali handknot. This technical innovation, executed in collaboration with our artisans, delivers a sculptural rug that changes character as you experience it: graphic from afar and richly textured up close.

[b]Size shown in imagery does not always represent the size available to buy online. If you require a larger size, please contact customer services directly.[/b]

For London Craft Week Paul Smith's Foundation launches an annual grant to celebrate British makers. entity.product_description_text:
Phoebe Stubbs discovered glass twenty years ago at an introductory workshop. The weight, heat, and tactility of the material left a lasting impression. She left interior design to train intensively, studied at the Rhode Island School of Design, and honed her craft alongside leading glassmakers through apprenticeships and assistant roles.

In 2020, with a distinct aesthetic and refined skillset, Phoebe founded Gather. Gather is a modern British glassmaking studio in Woolwich, London. We make handblown glassware, contemporary lighting and craft experiences, all shaped by hand in our London hotshop.

In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order. 

[b]Takt Natural[/b] is guided by the Bauhaus ideas of proportion and geometry, bringing pattern into a more tactile, dimensional space. Blocks of varied natural tones and shifting textures create a dimensional surface, while undyed New Zealand wool adds depth and a gentle vintage feel to the palette. 

Newly, Takt highlights two construction techniques: Tulu and Indo-Nepali handknot. This technical innovation, executed in collaboration with our artisans, delivers a sculptural rug that changes character as you experience it: graphic from afar and richly textured up close.

[b]Size shown in imagery does not always represent the size available to buy online. If you require a larger size, please contact customer services directly.[/b]

The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and 
Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order. 

[b]Axis Sand[/b] explores the precision of geometry through tactile form. Handknotted in New Zealand wool using the Tulu technique, alternating checks in contrasting neutral tones create varied layers of depth. The rug joins Bauhaus structure with Memphis Milano's playful edge, utilising gentle tonal variation to add warmth to its sense of order.

[b]Size shown in imagery does not always represent the size available to buy online. If you require a larger size, please contact customer services directly.[/b]

In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order. 

[b]Takt Natural[/b] is guided by the Bauhaus ideas of proportion and geometry, bringing pattern into a more tactile, dimensional space. Blocks of varied natural tones and shifting textures create a dimensional surface, while undyed New Zealand wool adds depth and a gentle vintage feel to the palette. 

Newly, Takt highlights two construction techniques: Tulu and Indo-Nepali handknot. This technical innovation, executed in collaboration with our artisans, delivers a sculptural rug that changes character as you experience it: graphic from afar and richly textured up close.

[b]Size shown in imagery does not always represent the size available to buy online. If you require a larger size, please contact customer services directly.[/b]

entity.care_info_text: Please note: All pieces have been hand made, therefore please expect each piece to be slightly unique from the original photos online.
entity.features_information_text:
For London Craft Week Paul Smith's Foundation launches an annual grant to celebrate British makers. 'British Makers - Glass' is a new initiative that gives a cash award to five British glassblowers to develop a new product in response to a creative brief, set by Sir Paul Smith - to reimagine the water jug. 

Glassblowers worked to specific briefs set out by the Paul Smith Home and Interiors team. These are: Humour, Pattern, Form, Stripe and Colour
entity.meta_description_text: Jochen Holz is a London-based master glass maker. Specialised in lampworking, Holz transforms high quality glass tubes into one-off glassware, bespoke objects, jewellery, and neon light sculptures. By letting the process and materiality of molten glass play a central role in his practice, a high level of spontaneous decisions and intuition are present in his design.

When lit, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and once burned, it can be reused again and again. Why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Fragrance notes: Rain, Iris, Suede, Patchouli 

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

entity.product_description_text:
Milonga by David Remfry (2012-2018)

[b]David Remfry[/b]

Born in Worthing in 1942, David Remfry studied at Hull College of Art (1959-64) before establishing himself as a full- time artist in London. Renowned for his large-scale watercolours of dancers and urban life, he captures the energy of nightlife- from Hull's Locarno dancehall in his student years to New York City clubs during his long residency at the Hotel Chelsea from 1995 to 2016. Where the Light Falls brings together key strands of Remfry's work, including his watercolours of dancers alongaide more recent oil paintings.

Remfry' was elected to the Royal Academy of Arts in 2006 where he served as Professor of Drawing at the RA Schools from 2016-18, and in 2023, he coordinated the Royal Academy's Summer Exhibition.

[b]David Remfry[/b]

Born in Worthing in 1942, David Remfry studied at Hull College of Art (1959-64) before establishing himself as a full- time artist in London. Renowned for his large-scale watercolours of dancers and urban life, he captures the energy of nightlife- from Hull's Locarno dancehall in his student years to New York City clubs during his long residency at the Hotel Chelsea from 1995 to 2016. Where the Light Falls brings together key strands of Remfry's work, including his watercolours of dancers alongaide more recent oil paintings.

Remfry' was elected to the Royal Academy of Arts in 2006 where he served as Professor of Drawing at the RA Schools from 2016-18, and in 2023, he coordinated the Royal Academy's Summer Exhibition.

This exhibition coincides with the release of a Monograph David Remfry published by Lund Humphries with essays by Chloe Aridjis, Hettie Judah, Rosalind McKever, Gerardine Mulcahy-Parker and Kathleen Soriano.

The exhibition has been curated by art historian and writer, Jo Baring.

entity.product_description_text:
Kit Kat Club by David Remfry (1999)

[b]David Remfry[/b]

Born in Worthing in 1942, David Remfry studied at Hull College of Art (1959-64) before establishing himself as a full- time artist in London. Renowned for his large-scale watercolours of dancers and urban life, he captures the energy of nightlife- from Hull's Locarno dancehall in his student years to New York City clubs during his long residency at the Hotel Chelsea from 1995 to 2016. Where the Light Falls brings together key strands of Remfry's work, including his watercolours of dancers alongaide more recent oil paintings.

Remfry' was elected to the Royal Academy of Arts in 2006 where he served as Professor of Drawing at the RA Schools from 2016-18, and in 2023, he coordinated the Royal Academy's Summer Exhibition.

This exhibition coincides with the release of a Monograph David Remfry published by Lund Humphries with essays by Chloe Aridjis, Hettie Judah, Rosalind McKever, Gerardine Mulcahy-Parker and Kathleen Soriano.

The exhibition has been curated by art historian and writer, Jo Baring.

entity.product_description_text:
Saudade by Abe Odedina 

[b]Abe Odedina[/b]

Born 1960 in Ibadan, Nigeria, Abe Odedina describes himself as a folk artist- yet, implicitly and explicitly, Odedina's practice questions the validity of 'folk art' as a discrete category. Odedina's work offers objects which embrace their objecthood: a gesture both radical and very simple indeed.

Painting on board rather than canvas, Odedina's compositions embody all the solidity- and practicality- of shop fronts or municipal murals. Compositional elements of Renaissance portraiture, devotional painting and even pop art frame figures from diverse mythologies (Yoruba, Haitian, Ancient Greek) as well as passers-by or characters plucked from the artist's own imagination.

Part of the Drawn Together exhibition

entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith for The Rug Company - Prisma Round Rug
entity.product_description_text:
Paul Smith has returned to collaborate with The Rug Company on a collection of seven new rugs, the designs experiment with familiar forms to create abstract motifs that inform the shape of the rugs. This collection encapsulates the evolution of a historic creative partnership while offering a new perspective on the relationship between color and shape.

Prisma plays with the Signature stripe, using a palette of both muted and deep hues that form around a rose-pink centre and gradually expand to the border. Comprised of 22 individual colours, each shade enriches the handknotted Tibetan wool with playful pigments. 

Available in a rectangular and round design, the latter experiments with a circular form to capture the effect of reverberation.

This collection encapsulates the evolution of a historic creative partnership while offering a new perspective on the relationship between colour and shape.

Spectra offers a sophisticated and subtle alternative to the colourful characteristic of the original stripe design. Rectangular blocks of colour use a spectrum of shades that are synonymous with the Paul Smith brand and shift across the surface in a regimented form. 

Each colour is handknotted in a lustrous silk thread that appears elevated against the rich density of the neutral wool base. This design complements transitional spaces, encouraging movement whilst enhancing surroundings with its contemporary take on colourful design.

entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith for The Rug Company - Prisma Rug - Small
entity.product_description_text:
Paul Smith has returned to collaborate with The Rug Company on a collection of seven new rugs, the designs experiment with familiar forms to create abstract motifs that inform the shape of the rugs. This collection encapsulates the evolution of a historic creative partnership while offering a new perspective on the relationship between color and shape.

Prisma plays with the Signature stripe, using a palette of both muted and deep hues that form around a rose-pink centre and gradually expand to the border. Comprised of 22 individual colours, each shade enriches the handknotted Tibetan wool with playful pigments. 

Available in a rectangular and round design, the latter experiments with a circular form to capture the effect of reverberation.

familiar forms to create abstract motifs that inform the shape of the rugs. This collection encapsulates the evolution of a historic creative partnership while offering a new perspective on the relationship between colour and shape.

A contemporary take on a classic design, Spray Swirl is inspired by the iconic Swirl design featured in Paul Smith’s first collection for The Rug Company.

entity.product_description_text:
Alvar Aalto's Screen 100, reimagined by Paul Smith.

The solid pine slats are individually stained using two of Artek's house finishes, and three custom ones made for Paul Smith. When combined, they create a muted version of our timeless 'Signature Stripe'.

Made of fine pinewood strips that have been vertically aligned, Screen 100 can be rolled up for storage and rolled out to form straight lines or fluid curves. The screen can be used to divide rooms or section off areas, and at 150 cm tall, it will add structure to a space without obscuring vision. Light, with balanced proportions, the screen is easy to move around as needed, and will bring the warmth of wood to any room in which it’s placed. Designed by Alvar Aalto, Screen 100 displays the Finnish master’s unmatched ability to meld traditional materials with organic shapes.

products.excerpt:
Now in its fourth edition, our collaboration with the iconic Swiss stationer is a celebration of colour and creativity, as well as Paul’s long-time love of the Caran d’Ache 849 pen.

With a two-tone colour scheme – a graphic nod to Paul’s popular stripe motifs – each combination has been carefully chosen to contrast, clash or coordinate, reflecting Paul’s clever use of colour.

Made in Switzerland with a strong aluminium hexagonal body and a flexible clip, this pen is finished with a Paul Smith signature on the body. 

Presented in a slim, padded case bearing the aforementioned two-tone colour scheme, this pen comes with a black medium Goliath ink cartridge which lasts up to 600 A4 pages.

Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. Once burned, why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

Fragrance notes: Lemon, Black Pepper, Vetiver, Moss.

CAUTION: Only burn this candle on a level, heat resistant surface. Do not burn for more than 4 hours at a time. Keep wick trimmed to 5mm. Stop using when 10mm of wax remains or wick disk becomes visible. Allow wax to harden before moving. Take care when extinguishing the flame. Keep candles 10cm apart and allow headroom for flame.
